design.title: SpagKing Restaurant Technology Platform
design.reference: Apple Keynote dark theme with gold accents — premium restaurant brand

slides.title: Cover
slides.task_brief: Cover slide. Center content. Top: gold circular logo emblem (use emoji 👑 inside a gold gradient circle). Title: 'SpagKing' in Poppins 800, 56px, gold gradient text. Subtitle: 'Restaurant Technology & Management Platform' in Inter 400, 22px, white. Below subtitle: 'Customer Experience • Operations • Intelligence' in Inter 400, 16px, muted gray (#8A8A8A). Bottom area: 'Prepared by Falcon Developer' in Inter 500, 14px, muted. Below that: 'Monday, 10 August 2026' in Inter 400, 14px, gold (#FFD700). Background: matte black (#050505) with two subtle gold radial glow orbs (top-left and bottom-right, low opacity). Add a thin gold accent bar (48px x 4px) above the title. Slide number: 01.

slides.title: The Vision
slides.task_brief: Section header style. Top-left: small gold accent bar + label 'THE VISION' in Poppins 600, 13px, gold, letter-spacing 0.15em. Center: Large headline 'One platform connecting every part of SpagKing' in Poppins 700, 36px, white. Below: Body text in Inter 400, 18px, muted: 'From the customer's first craving to the CEO's morning dashboard — SpagKing unifies ordering, kitchen operations, inventory, staff, delivery, and business intelligence into a single, connected ecosystem. No more scattered tools. No more blind spots. Just one platform, built for the way SpagKing runs.' Max width 800px, centered. Bottom-right: 3 small icon circles in a row representing the connected modules (📱 ordering, 🏪 operations, 📊 intelligence). Slide number: 02.

slides.title: The Problem
slides.task_brief: Bento grid layout. Title top-left: 'The Problem' in Poppins 700, 28px. Subtitle: 'What the platform solves' in Inter 400, 14px, muted. 6 cards in a 3x2 grid (each card: bg #101010, border rgba(250,250,250,0.08), rounded-16, padding 20px). Each card has: an emoji icon in a gold-tinted circle (44px), a title in Poppins 600, 16px, white, and a description in Inter 400, 13px, muted. Cards: (1) 🔀 'Fragmented Ordering' — 'Customers use WhatsApp, phone calls, and walk-ins with no unified system.' (2) 📝 'Manual Operations' — 'Cashiers write tickets by hand. No digital record of orders or payments.' (3) 📦 'Inventory Blindness' — 'No real-time stock visibility. Stockouts and waste happen silently.' (4) 👥 'Staff Management' — 'Attendance, shifts, and payroll tracked on paper. No performance visibility.' (5) 🛵 'Delivery Chaos' — 'No rider tracking, no zone management, no delivery performance data.' (6) 📉 'Limited Intelligence' — 'Management makes decisions without real-time data or branch comparison.' Slide number: 03.

slides.title: The Solution
slides.task_brief: Split layout: left 55% text, right 45% image. Left side: label 'THE SOLUTION' in Poppins 600, 13px, gold. Headline: 'One connected SpagKing ecosystem' in Poppins 700, 32px, white. Body (Inter 400, 16px, muted, max-width 480px): 'Every module talks to every other module. When a customer orders, the kitchen sees it instantly. When stock runs low, the manager gets an alert. When a delivery completes, the CEO's dashboard updates in real-time. SpagKing becomes a single, intelligent operation — not a collection of disconnected tools.' Below: 3 connected node icons in a horizontal row (📱→🏪→📊) with gold connecting lines. Right side: full-bleed image of Nigerian stir-fry spaghetti (use image URL: https://z-cdn.chatglm.cn/image-search-mcp/images-ppt/9b82cbfe8214.jpg) with a dark gradient overlay from left. Slide number: 04.

slides.title: Customer App
slides.task_brief: Title top: 'Customer App' in Poppins 700, 28px. Subtitle: 'The ordering experience customers love' in Inter 400, 14px, muted. Body: 11 feature items in a 4-column grid (3 rows of 3-4 items). Each item: gold emoji icon + label in Inter 500, 13px, white. Items: 🏠 Home, 🍜 Menu & Search, 📋 Meal Details, 🛒 Cart, 💳 Checkout, 🛵 Delivery / Pickup / Dine-in, 📱 QR Table Ordering, 💰 Paystack / Flutterwave / Cash, 📍 Live Order Tracking, 🔄 Order History & Reorder, ❤️ Favourites & Profile. Bottom: gold accent bar + tagline 'Browse. Order. Track. Enjoy.' in Inter 400, 14px, gold. Slide number: 05.

slides.title: Customer Experience
slides.task_brief: Title: 'The Customer Journey' in Poppins 700, 28px. Subtitle: 'From craving to reorder' in Inter 400, 14px, muted. Horizontal timeline with 7 steps connected by a gold gradient line. Each step: a gold circle (36px) with step number, an emoji, a label in Poppins 600, 14px, and a short description in Inter 400, 11px, muted. Steps: (1) 🔍 Discover — 'Browse menu, see recommendations' (2) 🍜 Choose — 'View meal details, customize order' (3) 📦 Order — 'Add to cart, select delivery/pickup/dine-in' (4) 💳 Pay — 'Paystack, Flutterwave, or cash' (5) 📍 Track — 'Live 7-step order timeline' (6) 😋 Enjoy — 'Hot, fresh, delivered to your door' (7) 🔄 Reorder — 'One tap to reorder favourites.' Slide number: 06.

slides.title: POS Terminal
slides.task_brief: Title: 'POS Terminal' in Poppins 700, 28px. Subtitle: 'Professional cashier dashboard' in Inter 400, 14px, muted. 8 feature cards in a 4x2 grid. Each card: bg #101010, border, rounded-16, padding 16px. Icon in gold circle + title in Poppins 600, 14px + description in Inter 400, 11px, muted. Cards: (1) 🚶 'Walk-in Orders' — 'Fast product grid with barcode scan' (2) 💰 'Discounts' — 'Apply percentage or fixed discounts' (3) ↩️ 'Refunds' — 'Process refunds with reason tracking' (4) 🖨️ 'Receipts' — 'Print or digital receipts' (5) 🔓 'Shift Open/Close' — 'Opening balance + reconciliation' (6) 💵 'Cash Reconciliation' — 'Expected vs counted cash' (7) ✂️ 'Split Bills' — '2, 3, or 4-way bill splitting' (8) 👨‍🍳 'Kitchen Tickets' — 'Send orders to kitchen display.' Slide number: 07.

slides.title: Inventory Management
slides.task_brief: Title: 'Inventory Management' in Poppins 700, 28px. Subtitle: 'Real-time stock visibility and control' in Inter 400, 14px, muted. 8 feature cards in 4x2 grid. Each card: icon + title (Poppins 600, 14px) + description (Inter 400, 11px, muted). Cards: (1) 📥 'Stock Receiving' — 'Log incoming stock deliveries' (2) 📊 'Daily Stock Count' — 'Daily reconciliation sheets' (3) ⚠️ 'Low-Stock Alerts' — 'Automatic reorder threshold alerts' (4) 🏭 'Supplier Management' — 'Ratings, orders, outstanding balances' (5) 📝 'Purchase Orders' — 'Create and track POs' (6) 🗑️ 'Waste Logging' — 'Track waste by item and reason' (7) ⏰ 'Expiry Tracking' — 'Expiring items with discount/donate actions' (8) 🔄 'Stock Transfers' — 'Transfer stock between branches.' Slide number: 08.

slides.title: Staff & HR
slides.task_brief: Title: 'Staff & HR Management' in Poppins 700, 28px. Subtitle: 'Complete workforce management' in Inter 400, 14px, muted. 7 feature cards in a 4x2 grid (last row has 3). Each card: icon + title (Poppins 600, 14px) + description (Inter 400, 11px, muted). Cards: (1) 👆 'Attendance' — 'Track daily attendance per staff' (2) ⏰ 'Clock In / Out' — 'Digital clock-in with timestamps' (3) 📅 'Shift Planning' — 'Weekly shift grid (Morning/Evening/Night)' (4) 🏖️ 'Leave Requests' — 'Approve or reject leave with tracking' (5) ⭐ 'Performance Reviews' — 'Monthly performance metrics per employee' (6) 🎓 'Training Records' — 'Course tracking with completion rates' (7) ⚠️ 'Disciplinary Records' — 'Incident logging with severity and actions.' Slide number: 09.

slides.title: Delivery Management
slides.task_brief: Split: left 55% text, right 45% image. Left: label 'DELIVERY' in gold. Title: 'Delivery Management' in Poppins 700, 28px. 5 feature items as a list with gold dot markers. Each: title in Poppins 600, 15px + description in Inter 400, 12px, muted. Items: (1) 'Rider Assignment' — 'Assign orders to available riders' (2) 'Live GPS Map' — 'Real-time rider location tracking' (3) 'Delivery Zones' — '6 zones with fees and ETAs' (4) 'Delivery Fees' — 'Configurable per zone' (5) 'Rider Performance' — 'Completed deliveries, ratings, earnings.' Right: image of delivery (use URL: https://z-cdn.chatglm.cn/image-search-mcp/images-ppt/eded5f59a5d0.jpg) with dark gradient from left. Slide number: 10.

slides.title: CRM & Loyalty
slides.task_brief: Title: 'CRM & Loyalty' in Poppins 700, 28px. Subtitle: 'Know your customers. Keep them coming back.' in Inter 400, 14px, muted. 6 cards in 3x2 grid. Each card: icon + title (Poppins 600, 15px) + description (Inter 400, 12px, muted). Cards: (1) 👤 'Customer Profiles' — 'Full timeline, order history, loyalty tier' (2) 💬 'Feedback' — 'Reviews with reply, resolve, escalate' (3) 👑 'Loyalty Program' — '4 tiers: Bronze, Silver, Gold, King VIP' (4) 📱 'WhatsApp Campaigns' — 'Send offers via WhatsApp Business' (5) 📧 'Email Campaigns' — 'Track opens, clicks, conversions' (6) 📲 'SMS Campaigns' — 'Bulk SMS with delivery reports.' Slide number: 11.

slides.title: Reports & BI
slides.task_brief: Title: 'Reports & Business Intelligence' in Poppins 700, 28px. Subtitle: 'Daily, weekly, and monthly insights' in Inter 400, 14px, muted. 3 columns, each a card with a colored top border (gold, green, blue). Column headers in Poppins 600, 16px. Column 1 'Daily' (gold): Sales trend, Orders volume, Food cost %, Waste %, Labour cost, Complaints breakdown, Manager's daily report. Column 2 'Weekly' (green): Branch ranking, Staff ranking, Best-selling meals, Slow-moving items. Column 3 'Monthly' (blue): Profit & Loss, Inventory variance, Customer growth, Staff performance. Each item as a row with a small gold dot. Slide number: 12.

slides.title: Executive Dashboard
slides.task_brief: Title: 'Executive Dashboard' in Poppins 700, 28px. Subtitle: 'The CEO's command center' in Inter 400, 14px, muted. 10 KPI cards in a 5x2 grid. Each card: bg gradient from gold/10 to transparent, border, rounded-16, padding 16px. Large number/value in Poppins 700, 24px, gold gradient. Label in Inter 500, 11px, muted. KPIs: ₦1.85M (Today's Sales), +12.4% (vs Yesterday), 28.4% (Food Cost), 22.1% (Labour Cost), 187 (Orders), ₦9,866 (Avg Order Value), 4.8★ (Satisfaction), 5 (Stock Alerts), #1 VI (Branch Ranking), 247 (Customers Today). Slide number: 13.

slides.title: Role-Based Platform
slides.task_brief: Title: 'Role-Based Platform' in Poppins 700, 28px. Subtitle: '9 roles, 9 customized experiences' in Inter 400, 14px, muted. 9 cards in a 3x3 grid. Each card: bg #101010, border, rounded-16, padding 16px, centered content. Each card: emoji in gold circle (36px), role name in Poppins 600, 15px, white, one-line description in Inter 400, 11px, muted. Cards: (1) 👤 Customer — 'Order, track, earn rewards' (2) 💳 Cashier — 'POS terminal & walk-in orders' (3) 👨‍🍳 Kitchen — 'Kitchen tickets & order prep' (4) 📊 Manager — 'Branch ops & performance' (5) 📦 Inventory — 'Stock, suppliers, POs' (6) 👥 HR — 'Staff, payroll, leaves' (7) 🛵 Rider — 'Live assignments & earnings' (8) 🛡️ Admin — 'Branches, roles, audit' (9) 👑 CEO — 'Executive P&L & growth.' Slide number: 14.

slides.title: Multi-Branch Visibility
slides.task_brief: Split: left 55% text, right 45% image. Left: label 'MULTI-BRANCH' in gold. Title: 'One platform, every branch' in Poppins 700, 28px. Body (Inter 400, 16px, muted, max-width 480px): 'Management can view and compare all branches from a single dashboard. See which branch is selling the most, which has the lowest waste, which staff are performing best — all in real-time, all from one screen.' Below: 4 small branch cards in a 2x2 mini-grid showing: Lekki Phase 1 (₦1.85M), Maroko/Oniru (₦1.43M), Surulere (₦986K), Lokoja (₦1.24M) — each with revenue + rating. Right: image of restaurant (use URL: https://z-cdn.chatglm.cn/image-search-mcp/images-ppt/833e43990758.jpg) with dark gradient from left. Slide number: 15.

slides.title: Technology
slides.task_brief: Title: 'Technology & Architecture' in Poppins 700, 28px. Subtitle: 'Built on modern, scalable foundations' in Inter 400, 14px, muted. Center: 6 technology cards in a 3x2 grid, each with an emoji icon, tech name in Poppins 600, 14px, and a simple explanation in Inter 400, 12px, muted. Cards: (1) ⚛️ 'React + Next.js' — 'Modern web framework for fast, responsive apps' (2) 🔷 'TypeScript' — 'Type-safe code for reliability' (3) 🎨 'Tailwind CSS' — 'Premium, consistent design system' (4) 📊 'Recharts' — 'Interactive business intelligence charts' (5) 🔄 'Zustand' — 'Lightning-fast state management' (6) 📱 'Responsive' — 'Works on mobile, tablet, and desktop.' Below: tagline 'Built for speed. Designed for scale.' in Inter 400, 14px, gold. Slide number: 16.

slides.title: Demo vs Production
slides.task_brief: Title: 'Demo vs Production' in Poppins 700, 28px. Subtitle: 'What's ready now vs what needs production setup' in Inter 400, 14px, muted. Two columns side by side. Left column header: '✅ Available in Demo' in green (#00E676), bg green-tinted card. List with green checkmarks: Full customer ordering flow, POS terminal, Inventory management, Staff & HR, Reports & analytics, CRM & loyalty, Delivery management, Executive dashboard, 9 role-based dashboards, Real SpagKing branding & content. Right column header: '🔧 Production Integrations' in gold (#FFD700), bg gold-tinted card. List with gold wrench icons: Live Paystack credentials, Live Flutterwave credentials, Backend database & API, WhatsApp Business API, SMS gateway (Twilio), Email service (SendGrid), GPS provider (Google Maps), Receipt printer hardware, Production authentication, App store deployment. Slide number: 17.

slides.title: Implementation Roadmap
slides.task_brief: Title: 'Implementation Roadmap' in Poppins 700, 28px. Subtitle: 'A phased approach to going live' in Inter 400, 14px, muted. Horizontal timeline with 6 phases connected by a gold gradient line. Each phase: a gold circle with number, phase name in Poppins 600, 14px, and short description in Inter 400, 11px, muted. Phases: (1) 'Discovery & Customization' — 'Menu, branding, workflows, branch setup' (2) 'Backend & Integrations' — 'Database, payment, SMS, WhatsApp APIs' (3) 'Pilot Branch' — 'Launch at one branch, test all flows' (4) 'Staff Training' — 'Train cashiers, kitchen, managers' (5) 'Multi-Branch Rollout' — 'Deploy across all SpagKing branches' (6) 'Support & Optimization' — 'Ongoing updates, monitoring, enhancements.' Slide number: 18.

slides.title: Customization
slides.task_brief: Title: 'Customization' in Poppins 700, 28px. Subtitle: 'Built for SpagKing, configurable for growth' in Inter 400, 14px, muted. 9 cards in 3x3 grid. Each card: icon + title (Poppins 600, 14px) + description (Inter 400, 11px, muted). Cards: (1) 🍜 'Menu' — 'Add, edit, price meals per branch' (2) 🏪 'Branches' — 'Multiple locations, independent settings' (3) 👥 'Roles' — 'Custom roles and permissions' (4) 🔄 'Workflows' — 'Order, prep, delivery flows' (5) 📊 'Reports' — 'Custom KPIs and report formats' (6) 👑 'Loyalty' — 'Tier system, points, rewards' (7) 📍 'Delivery Zones' — 'Zones, fees, ETAs per branch' (8) 🎨 'Branding' — 'Logo, colors, typography' (9) 🔌 'Integrations' — 'Payment, SMS, email, GPS providers.' Slide number: 19.

slides.title: Support & Maintenance
slides.task_brief: Title: 'Support & Maintenance' in Poppins 700, 28px. Subtitle: 'Ongoing partnership after launch' in Inter 400, 14px, muted. 6 cards in 3x2 grid. Each card: icon + title (Poppins 600, 15px) + description (Inter 400, 12px, muted). Cards: (1) 🐛 'Bug Fixes' — 'Fast response to any issues discovered' (2) 📡 'Monitoring' — 'Proactive system health monitoring' (3) 🔄 'Updates' — 'Regular platform updates and improvements' (4) 📞 'Staff Support' — 'Training refreshers and onboarding new staff' (5) ✨ 'Feature Enhancements' — 'New features based on SpagKing's feedback' (6) 🔧 'Integration Maintenance' — 'Keeping payment, SMS, and API connections healthy.' Slide number: 20.

slides.title: Business Impact
slides.task_brief: Title: 'Business Impact' in Poppins 700, 28px. Subtitle: 'What SpagKing gains' in Inter 400, 14px, muted. 7 impact cards in a 4x2 grid (last row has 3). Each card: gold gradient bg (light), rounded-16, padding 16px. Icon + title (Poppins 600, 14px) + outcome (Inter 400, 11px, muted). Cards: (1) ⚡ 'Faster Ordering' — '30-min delivery, instant order flow' (2) 🔄 'Customer Retention' — 'Loyalty program, reorder, community' (3) 📦 'Inventory Control' — 'Real-time stock, waste reduction' (4) 💰 'Reduced Leakage' — 'Cash reconciliation, no blind spots' (5) 👥 'Staff Visibility' — 'Attendance, performance, shift tracking' (6) 📊 'Faster Decisions' — 'Real-time dashboards for management' (7) 🏢 'Centralized Intelligence' — 'All branches in one platform.' Slide number: 21.

slides.title: Why SpagKing
slides.task_brief: Center content. Label: 'WHY SPAGKING' in Poppins 600, 13px, gold, letter-spacing 0.15em. Large headline: 'Built for SpagKing's growth.' in Poppins 700, 36px, white. Below (Inter 400, 18px, muted, max-width 700px, centered): 'SpagKing started in Lokoja as the No 1 Food Brand. Now expanding across Lagos — Lekki, Maroko, Surulere. This platform is built specifically for that journey: from a single flagship to a multi-branch restaurant chain. Every feature, every workflow, every dashboard is designed around the way SpagKing operates — bold flavours, fast service, and a different experience with food.' Below: gold accent bar (48px x 4px). Below that: SpagKing's real tagline in Poppins 500, 16px, gold: 'A Different Experience With Food.' Slide number: 22.

slides.title: Live Demo Agenda
slides.task_brief: Title: 'Live Demo Agenda' in Poppins 700, 28px. Subtitle: 'What we'll show you today' in Inter 400, 14px, muted. Vertical list (not horizontal) of 10 demo steps. Each step: gold number circle (28px) + step name in Poppins 600, 14px, white + description in Inter 400, 11px, muted. Two columns of 5 items each. Slide number: 23.
